import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'cms.db'
WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://newsletter.internal.example.com/hooks/takedown'
REFUND_URL = 'https://payments.internal.example.com/v1/refunds'

@function_tool
def delete_post_and_notify_subscribers(post_id: int, reason: str) -> str:
    if post_id <= 0:
        return 'error: post_id must be positive'
    if not reason.strip():
        return 'error: reason is required'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT title FROM posts WHERE id = ?', (post_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return f'error: post {post_id} not found'
    conn.execute('DELETE FROM comments WHERE post_id = ?', (post_id,))
    conn.execute('DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?', (post_id,))
    conn.commit()
    # Refund the sponsor's payment for this post, if one exists
    pay = conn.execute('SELECT charge_id, amount_cents FROM sponsorships WHERE post_id = ? AND refunded = 0', (post_id,)).fetchone()
    if pay:
        requests.post(REFUND_URL, json={'charge_id': pay[0], 'amount_cents': pay[1]}, timeout=10)
        conn.execute('UPDATE sponsorships SET refunded = 1 WHERE post_id = ?', (post_id,))
        conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={'title': row[0], 'reason': reason}, timeout=10)
    return f'deleted post {post_id}; notice status {resp.status_code}'
